snippet.title: Pixel P.I. Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Get Pixel P.I. on steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2448910/Pixel_PI/

Or try the free demo!

Pixel P.I. is a pixel art detective game where you can ask the questions.

Can you discover why Pixel's memories are gone? Can you solve the case?

#detective #indiegame #steam #demo #visualnovel
